```{r}
#"ross.s2.1_1_TEXT= % of peers who would pay the fine; 
# ross.s2.1_2_TEXT=% of your peers who would go to court; 
# ross.s2.2=would you pay the fine or appear in court? 1=pay, 2=appear in court"
```
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

data_raw <- read_csv(here("data", "False Consensus 2 (Ross et al., 1977)", "Ross.2", "Global", "Data", "Ross_2_study_global_include_all_CLEAN_CASE.csv"))
```

```{r}
data <- data_raw |> mutate(percent_pay = ross.s2.1_1_TEXT,
               own_choice = ross.s2.2) |> 
  select(uID, percent_pay, own_choice, sex, Location, Country, Language)
```

```{r}
## Demographics

## Count the number of participants run at each study site
data |> group_by(Location) |> count()
```
